'''Thoma's Master''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. Their apprentice [[Thoma]] was killed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="NS" />
